title: In-lane drag sends the reorder by the one write path, refusals shown
goal: A drag on the graph ends as the same reviewed PR as the list, or a refusal with its reason
acceptance: The graph's reorderRequest goes through the same call and approval card as the solution-order list (F-150-T01), which opens a reviewed PR for the owner to merge; no other write path exists in NERV, and nothing is merged by NERV
A refusal from the component or from the path ("X depends on Y", stale base) is shown on the card and the graph reloads; the drag between dependent items is refused before any call is made
Tests across the join (graph to reorder call to fake coordinator): accepted move, move across a dependency, stale base
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: The card's reorder call exists (F-150-T01); this wires the graph's reorderRequest to it and shows the refusal. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
